Remark
[Growing normalized neck length] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0390 1. appD:D.15\group Rotational Neckpinches

If $L(t)=o(\sqrt{\log (1/(T-t))})$, then for each $\varepsilon >0$ and all sufficiently late times the flow contains an embedded $\varepsilon $-neck of normalized length $L(t)$.
